name: Perejti Rubikon
source:
Cross the Rubicon is an action—packed modification that started with not the funniest joke and ended with not the funniest story. The story comes from different people who have the bad luck to get into the atmosphere of eternal summer and serenity, and it is not even clear how true this atmosphere will be.
The modification provides you with an incredible opportunity to go through the stories of six friends who are located between the will of various unknown forces and those who want outside help.
Will the assistant be able to get rid of the sudden circumstances and reunite with his beloved, or will he become a completely new person?
Will the detective be able to solve the case of what is happening in the camp and survive after it ends?
Will the troubadour be able to stand the test of time, place, and two particularly temperamental women outside of the situations presented to him?
Will the culprit be able to sort out the illusions of his world and realize what he has done?
And whether the forgotten one can...
